mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over the last two months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it indicates inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the last quarter, coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the same period, indicates a strong supply side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 0.5% and INDPRO increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.
